content.text: I tɑmɑɑ Gusunɔ kun dɑm mɔwɑ
u kɑ bɛɛ fɑɑbɑ ko?
I tɑmɑɑ u ǹ swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ bɛɛn ɡɑri nɔ?
Aɑwo, n ǹ mɛ.
I n yɛ̃ mɑ bɛɛn tiin durum sɔ̃nɑ i kɑrɑnɛ kɑ wi.
Bɛɛn torɑnun sɔ̃nɑ u bɛɛ biru kisi,
mɑ yɑ derɑ u ǹ mɑɑ bɛɛn ɡere swɑɑ dɑki.
Bɛɛn nɔmɑ yɑ yɛm yibɑ, domi i tɔmbu ɡo.
Weesu kɑ ɡɑri kɔ̃siyɑ yi yɑrimɔ bɛɛn nɔsun di.
Weesɑ i rɑ n kɑ bɛɛn berusebu siribu sokumɔ.
Bɛɛn ɡoo ku rɑ kɑ ɡem siribu de.
Seedɑ weesuɡiɑ sɔɔrɑ i rɑ n tɑ̃sɑ siri yeru mi.
Kɔ̃sɑ i rɑ bwisiku kpɑ i kom kɔ̃sum ko.
Bɛɛn himbɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sunu
nɡe wɑɑn sɛ̃ɑ.
Bɑ̀ n ye kɔrɑ,
surɔkɔrɑ tɑ rɑ yɑnde yɑri min di.
Wi u ye di u ko n ɡbimɔwɑ.
Bɛɛn bwisikunu nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe nɑrɑn wɛ̃ɛ yi yɑ tɑrimɔ.
N ǹ mɔ yi wɑ̃ɑ yi kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu ko,
nɡe bekuru te tɔnu koo wukiri,
mɑ n kun mɔ yi kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu yinɑ mwɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɛɛn nɔmɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ,
yɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ yu kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko.
I rɑ n sɛndewɑ i kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko,
kpɑ i n nɑɑsu sɑ̃u i kɑ tɔnun yɛm yɑri kɑm.
I rɑ n bwisikumɔwɑ i kɑ tɔmbu kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ,
kpɑ i n tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ
i n ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑmɔ mi i duɑ kpuro.
I ǹ ɑlɑfiɑn swɑɑ yɛ̃.
Bɛɛn sɑnu sɑnusu ku rɑ mɑɑ ɡem swĩi,
sere swɛɛ yi yi ǹ dɛnde.
Wi u ɡesi bɛɛn swɛɛ yi mwɑ kpuro,
u ku rɑ bɔri yɛndu wɑ.
Isirelibɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛn torɑnun sɔ̃nɑ
wunɛ Yinni Gusunɔn fɑɑbɑ yɑ tɛɛmɔ
yèn nɔɔ mwɛɛru ɑ sun kuɑ.
Sɑ yɑm bururɑm mɑrɑ,
ɑdɑmɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔrɑ sɑ sĩimɔ kɑ tɛ̃.
Sɑ mɑrɑ sɔ̃ɔ u yɑri,
ɑdɑmɑ yɑm mu tĩriwɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
Sɑ sĩimɔ sɑ bɑ̃ɑrimɔ
nɡe wɔ̃ko wi u ɡɑnɑ bɑbi.
Mɑ sɑ sokikirɑmɔ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ
nɡe wi u wɑ̃ɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ.
Bɑɑ mɛ sɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do,
bɛsɛ kɑ ɡonu sɑ kuɑ tiɑ.
Sɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ nɡe yɑɑ ɡɔbɑ,
mɑ sɑ sumɔ nɡe kpɑrukonu.
Yinni Gusunɔ, sɑ mɑrɑ ɑ sun yɑkiɑ,
ɑdɑmɑ wunɛn fɑɑbɑ yɑ kɑ sun tondɑ.
N ǹ koore su ye wɑ.
Domi bɛsɛn torɑnu kpɛ̃ɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ,
mɑ bɛsɛn durum yɑ bɛsɛn dɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ.
Sɑ bɛsɛn torɑnu yɛ̃ ni nu sun wɑ̃ɑsi.
Sɑ kuɑ tɑɑrɛɡibu kɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑriruɡibu
wunɛ Yinni Gusunɔn mi.
Sɑ nun deri wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn Yinni,
mɑ sɑ nun seesi,
sɑ tɔmbu dɑm dɔre.
Bwisiku weesuɡinɑ nu rɑ n yibɑ bɛsɛn ɡɔ̃rusɔ.
Yerɑ n derɑ ɡem kun kɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ,
mɑ fɑɑbɑ yɑ kɑ sun tondɑ.
Gem mu ku rɑ mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsire mi tɔmbɑ mɛnnɛ.
Sɑ rɑ mu tɛɛsiwɑ.
Gem mu kpɑ.
Wi u mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ suurimɔ
bɑ rɑ nùn wɔriwɑ bu win yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ.

content: Yinni Gusunɔ u koo tɔmbu sɛɛyɑsiɑ

content.text: Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ mɑ ɡem kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ,
yɑ ǹ kɑ nùn nɑɑwɛ.
Mɑ u biti kuɑ, yèn sɔ̃ ɡoo kun yen ɡɑri mɔ̀.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ win tii u ɡɔ̃ru doke u win dɑm sɔ̃ɔsi.
Mɑ u tɑ̃sɑ win ɡem sɔɔ,
u mu sebuɑ nɡe tɑrɑkpe,
mɑ u fɑɑbɑ doke wirɔ nɡe sii furɔ kɔkɔru.
U mɔru kɔsiɑbu sebuɑ nɡe yɑberu,
mɑ u tii nisinu wukiri nɡe ɡurumusuru.
U koo bɑɑwure siri
nɡe mɛ̀n nɔɔ win kookoosu nɛ,
kpɑ u kɑ win yibɛrɛbɑ mɔru ko,
bɑɑ be bɑ kɑ nùn tomɑ,
kpɑ bu win yĩsiru nɑsiɑ
kpɑ win yiiko yu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ
sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di
n kɑ dɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yerɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ koo nɑ nɡe dɑɑ bɑkɑrun nim,
Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u koo bu ɡirɑ bu doonɑ.
Fɑɑbɑ kowo u koo nɑ Yerusɑlɛmun sɔ̃,
kɑ sere mɑɑ Isirelibɑ be bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑn sɔ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni ɡeruɑ.

content: U mɑɑ nɛɛ, win ɑrukɑwɑni wee, ye u kɑ bu bɔkumɔ. Win Hunde u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ be sɔɔ, kpɑ u win ɡɑri doke ben nɔsɔ. Yin ɡɛɛ kun doonɔ ben nɔsun di, sere n kɑ dɑ ben bibun bibun nɔsɔ, sɑɑ tɛ̃n di sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Wi, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni ɡeruɑ.
